faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does a salon interior designer in Chhattarpur plan for a new salon?

We plan the full floor: reception, waiting area, styling stations, wash basins, treatment rooms and storage. Plumbing, power points and lighting are fixed before any furniture is made, so the salon works smoothly from the first day.

Can an existing salon be redesigned without closing it for long?

Yes. The work can be split into phases, for example treatment rooms first and the main floor later, so the salon keeps serving clients. We share the sequence and site plan before work starts.

Why hire a salon specialist instead of only a contractor?

A salon interior designer thinks about client flow, mirror lighting, easy-to-clean finishes and staff movement, not only looks. These details decide how comfortable clients feel and how smoothly the team works through a busy day.

Do you take up salon projects outside Chhattarpur?

Yes. Along with Chhattarpur, we design salons across South Delhi, Gurgaon and the rest of Delhi NCR.
